description: This file defines the 'Customer' class within the 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Mail' namespace. It contains methods to handle email notifications for customer approval ('approve') and denial ('deny'), including loading configuration, localization, and task scheduling.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class handling customer approval and denial email notifications in the admin panel.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Schedules an email task to approve a customer, gathering store, language, and logo info to generate email content.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Schedules an email task to deny a customer, similar to 'approve' but for rejection notification.
